title: Equity Cradle
one_liner: Simulate a kid's SpaceX share or birth dividend compounding to age 65, and what they lose by selling early.
speaker: Chamath Palihapitiya
context: Elon pledged one SpaceX share (~$146) to every American kid via Trump accounts; Chamath proposed a locked $2,000 birth dividend, and hosts debated kids holding versus dumping shares.
demo: Visitor picks a birth year and an asset (SpaceX fractional share at $146 or a $2,000 birth dividend), sets a growth-rate slider with presets from the episode's figures, and watches an animated compound-growth chart run to age 65. A 'sell now' button shows exactly how much future value gets forfeited versus holding.
data_plan: Bundled podcast figures (72M kids, $10.5B total gift, $146/kid, SpaceX share price $1,408, Dell gift of $250/kid) plus user input and a simulated compound-growth curve.
risks: Growth-rate presets (e.g. 'orders of magnitude bigger than Earth's economy') are speculative; must be labeled as illustrative, not financial advice.

episode.title: Chamath: AGI Is Here, Anthropic’s $100B Giveaway, Elon’s SpaceX Shares for 72M Kids | EP #304
